local:contact-habitats.note: private journal state; contact-scoped personalities, source-backed remembered observations and owner tool configuration, bounded observation and tool-result evidence, at-most-once checkpoint claims and conditional host-owned promotion

local:habitat-evidence.source: bounded Algal executions of contact programs
local:habitat-evidence.note: private complete manifest and run receipt pairs; retained evidence replays without live provider calls; oldest evidence is evicted on new publication

local:api-reservations.note: global UTC-day reservations committed before Gateway or Exa requests; ambiguous results retain their reservation and operation identity; provider-reported costs replace estimates through api-settlements; production keys also carry a provider-enforced daily quota

local:api-settlements.note: generationId-keyed provider cost confirmations; idempotent per operation and generation identity, orphaned rows are pruned with their reservations

provider:habitat-gateway.source: explicit owner-selected fast-driver configuration and contact context
provider:habitat-gateway.note: fixed Gateway origin and Alibaba provider allowlist; no automatic provider fallback, top-up or uncertain retry; generation-info metadata reads settle provider-reported cost into the same daily ledger

provider:habitat-gateway-exa.source: plan-gated model search requests admitted by private-corpus query filtering
provider:habitat-gateway-exa.note: server-side Exa tool via the same Gateway key and daily ledger; webSearch is off in the default plan; queries with identifier shapes, private 2-3 word spans, or private proper nouns are refused; results are untrusted excerpts

local:public-meme-catalog.note: in-memory catalog only; queries are matched locally and never sent to Imgflip; not full-library search

local:public-meme-assets.note: catalog-bound JPEG/PNG bytes published privately by the trusted media broker; no arbitrary URLs, caption uploads, or automatic send

local:owner-imported-media.note: explicit CLI imports into one contact outbox; content-addressed no-clobber publication makes repeated imports idempotent; model text tools cannot import external paths

local:owner-message-context.source: explicit bounded reads from one enrolled messaging conversation
local:owner-message-context.note: history and summaries are owner control responses; omitted and shortened evidence is reported; attachment content is not retrieved

local:owner-reply-drafts.source: owner-specified or selected-agent actions and current recipient context
local:owner-reply-drafts.note: in-memory drafts bind full disclosed content, asset digests and exact recipient; explicit send remains a separate journaled operation

local:macos-app-upgrades.note: private retained signed app and exact old/new receipts; transition journal is released only after proven completion or rollback; uncertain transitions preserve both versions

local:imessage-setup-reconciliation.note: explicit legacy crash witness and write-once body-free settlement bind the original attempt, source, app, crash and quiescence; original results remain intact

served:textbutler-macos-app.note: locally reproducible native supervisor, fixed Info.plist and signature resource; exact inventory and bounded artifact hashing; runtime payload remains separately installed

local:imessage-setup-binding.note: private write-once account and subject digests preserve first accepted identity across failed attempts; removed only with explicit settled installation data erasure

local:imessage-setup-launch.source: explicit owner setup launch and exact installed app identity
local:imessage-setup-launch.note: private launchd plist and custody record; exact completed launches remove their artifacts, uncertain launches remain for reconciliation

local:macos-app-installation.source: verified installed runtime and native app artifacts
local:macos-app-installation.note: private app identity and artifact pins; no message content or credentials; preserve mismatched identities for reviewed recovery

local:imessage-setup-results.source: explicit owner iMessage setup attempts and connector settlement
local:imessage-setup-results.note: private body-free progress and configuration digests; bounded archive stops new setup when full; uncertain custody is retained for reconciliation

local:xcb-application-exchange.source: contact-scoped task context and XCB application settlement
local:xcb-application-exchange.note: bounded private stdio; no prompt or provider stderr logging; subscription metering and credential custody remain in XCB

served:textbutler-local-runtime.note: reproducible local pilot runtime bundles; integrity metadata does not qualify provider execution

local:style-profile.note: local JSON style-profile store; private, never leaves the device

served:oh-archive-strict-wasm.note: optional WASM fast path for the strict X-archive reader; TypeScript remains authoritative
